limits: Instrumented Web Audio API scheduling/graph tests, not a rendered browser audio capture or a listening assessment. Device speakers, perceptual loudness, and audio-to-screen latency still require on-device listening.

results.name: Public interface stays unchanged; audio remains lazy and unsupported browsers stay playable
The first gesture cue survives async resume without duplicate resume calls
Blocked or stale unlock events never replay a backlog of old effects
Stress measurement
Dense mixed events stay within sixteen voices and forty oscillators, at most four per note
The final output curve is symmetric, finite, monotonic, and bounded below0.69
The mix bus runs master, filters, a gentle compressor and a fixed trim into the ceiling
One shared reverb: a generated dark stereo impulse on three sends, returning into the master
Reverb missing, rejected or throwing falls back to a dry mix without interrupting play
Every cue type plays without throwing, stays under the caps, and lands every pitch in C major
Variation is gentle and safe: a stubbed Math.random never breaks a cue or makes it louder
Bloom cues begin immediately with soft attacks and moderate harmonic frequencies
Chains walk the bloom chords, and shimmer and fever arpeggiate the chord the chain is on
Planting unfolds in four bounded notes; repeated cues stay capped and mute cancels the pending phrase
Moon gates play a quiet two-note response, debounce rapid crossings, and obey mute and voice limits
All ten guardian warnings start immediately with distinct restrained colors and finish before the attack
Actual controller warning events retain at least 1.2 seconds of lead and all reach the sound handler
Guard, weakspot and burned-seed sounds differ, debounce fast impacts, and obey mute
A boss warning retains reserved room during a dense bloom chain without exceeding caps
Koi currents play two quiet rising water drops and debounce lane re-entry
Each meadow friend has its own short, quiet voice; taps are debounced and unknown friends stay silent
Rush waves climb one C major scale step per wave up to a fifth, and a cleared wave rings a bounded rising chord
Big moments flourish over a soft chord, finish within about a second, and stay soft
Losing stays gentle: falling notes that land on home, quieter than a win
Result stars chime upward one by one, the third a touch fuller, and three in a row all play
Position changes restrained stereo pan, with mono fallback for older implementations
Mute fades existing and future notes, blocks new effects, and re-enables cleanly
setEnabled(false) fades every voice and the master smoothly, anchored at the current time (no clicks)
Nodes are disconnected when voices end; only the shared bus stays connected
The room is built just after the first gesture, so the first sound never waits on it
Repeated wake calls reuse the context and closed contexts recover safely
Crisp transients run through one seeded noise buffer and a band at or under 3.6 kHz, then clean up
A new best cuts the tail of the losing phrase and plays its sparkle fanfare
The seed ladder climbs the chord (root, third, fifth, octave) and stays in it, within 140 Hz to 1.1 kHz
Each flower blooms in its own instrument: gold bell, coral marimba, lilac harp, sky glass, poppy pan
Finale cues: the roll swells and is cut by the impact; won waits for the sweep; a finale wave adds no cleared cue
Rising cues climb: sweep, plucks, tally, sun petals and the multiplier all go up in C major
Without an offline renderer the music is silently off, and the music calls never throw
